routes.purpose: Whole app origin for the private video-utils review BFF. Every path stays behind the all-paths Cloudflare Access application in video-utils-access-plan.json; the origin additionally verifies the Access JWT and the operator allowlist (AUTH_HOSTING_S3.md section 4.5).

notes: Modelled on xoxd-ai/tinyland.dev infra/cloudflare/honey-ingress-mothership-xoxd-ai-routes.json (github/main 7422982619e357d31a0ddf0affdf8dedd0b51a93, path commit 8a80a74805a2c0efc1ca60b4e3f7f8428ef22934, 2026-09-19): a source-controlled expected route contract applied out of band against a shared Cloudflare Tunnel, never by a script or workflow in this repository.

tunnelName, tunnelId, hostname and publicAppOrigin are null pending operator decision; the estate pattern uses the shared honey-ingress tunnel, but which cluster and tunnel serve video-utils is not decided (cluster_target unknown).
Order (xoruby pattern, tinyland-infra tofu/stacks/xoxd-ai-edge README): Access gate first and read back, then this tunnel route, then the proxied DNS record. Rollback in reverse.
Applying this file is an outward-facing operator act requiring a separate go (deploy/README.md).
